method: Each course /fees page (kcl.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/courses/<slug>/fees) was fetched; their bodies came back empty of fee content (only metadata: "Start date: September 2027"), so no course-level fee could be read. kcl.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/fees-and-funding/tuition-fees only states a 2026-entry Home figure (not recorded). The KCL Student Services Online article KA-02161 (official kcl.ac.uk subdomain) states the 2027/28 Home undergraduate full-time fee; used for Home. No 2027/28 International figure found on any official page fetched. Gap-fill pass 2026-10-01 for International fee: no 2027/28 figure found (see per-course notes).

universityWideStatements.quote: There will also be an increase in tuition fees for the year 2027/28, which will be an increase of 2.68% to £10,050 for home undergraduate students on full-time courses, in line with the fee cap set by the Government.
universityWideStatements.title: When do tuition fees increase and by how much? · Student Services Online
universityWideStatements.appliesTo: Home undergraduate students on full-time courses, 2027/28. Article is about fee increases and does not literally say "new entrants"; no "to be confirmed/subject to approval" caveat appears in it.
